summary: Authored the test project: a hermetic WebApplicationFactory (isolated SQLite file per class), integration tests covering acceptance criteria AC1-AC8, and unit tests for the Base62 generator and the URL/alias validator.

files.reason: xUnit + Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing, references the API project.
Boots the real app against a temp SQLite file; settings overridable per test class.
AC1 create, AC2 redirect, AC3 404, AC4 invalid URLs, AC5 alias/409, AC6 expiry/410, AC7 delete, AC8 health.
Generator length/alphabet/uniqueness; validator accept/reject matrix; alias rules.

risks: The expiry test sleeps ~600ms; acceptable but a clock abstraction would make it instantaneous.
assumptions: Tests may run in parallel across classes because each class owns its database file.
